source: Google Sheet: Forged and Sent Women's Workout Library (1srKHSbZfVFY_y8tXRpj7aD8CKOrFVpf48TJMxcmukkw)

programs.Rooted: Strength, glute and leg forward, with bone loading

restDayRule: Place templateDay 7 on the user's chosen weekday and count forward, so templateDay 1 is the day after the rest day. Plan day 1 starts on the first date that is the day after the rest day. Optional (templateDay 6) is shown only when the user turns on the 4th training day.
notes: day = plan day 1-365. templateDay = ((day-1) mod 7)+1. Day 365 is templateDay 1 of week 53. exercises are [generic movement, prescription]; resolve the movement through movements.json byEquipment[setup]. theme details (warmup, finisher, notes) are in workout-themes.json keyed 'Program|templateDay'.
sessionDesign: Core days (templateDay 1, 3, 5) are full-body sessions in Rooted and Sculpted, and full-body power sessions in Valkyrie (days 1 and 3). Pulse and Valkyrie day 5 stay conditioning circuits. Optional day 6 is a lighter full-body or conditioning session; in Rooted it adds soft-landing jumps (BONE slot) and carries for bone loading.
movementsNote: movements.json is the full women's exercise library for custom plans (includes the Rest Day entry). Some movements are not used in any scheduled day. Each has a 'video' object {url, channel, views}, except Rest Day; the 9 movements added for this library have channel and views null.
warmupDesign: Each Core and Optional day has a 'warmup' list of [movement, prescription] pairs: cardio primer, mobility, activation, and a bodyweight primer matched to the day's main pattern. No warm-up movement needs a barbell or dumbbells. Pairs resolve through movements.json like exercises. Recovery and Rest days have an empty list and use the theme warmup text. For Core/Optional days the theme 'warmup' text is only a generic fallback line.
alternatesDesign: alternates.json maps movement -> reason -> up to 4 swap movements (nearest first). Reasons: No Barbell, No Bench, No Pull-Up Bar, No Cable or Machine, Knee, Hip, Low Back, Shoulder, Elbow or Wrist, Low Impact, Pelvic Floor, Any Discomfort. Pelvic Floor replaces jumping, running and straining core work with lower-pressure options. Not medical advice.
cycleNotesNote: cycle-notes.json holds optional cycle-phase prompts. Core and Optional day notes in workout-themes.json include one optional sentence pointing to them. They are suggestions, not rules.
toggleNote: Separate set for the sex toggle: load seed/women/* when the user selects female, and seed/* (root) for male. Same schema in both.
recoveryDesign: Recovery days (templateDay 2 and 4) need no equipment in every setup: an easy walk or jog plus floor, wall and bodyweight mobility. Their movements resolve to the same equipment-free exercise in all four setups.
coachingDesign: Day-level warm-up, finisher and coaching notes are written for a first-time gym goer in a personal trainer voice (purpose, RPE and RIR explained, rest times, progression, deload, soreness, scaling). Each movement also has a long-form howTo (Setup, Move, Watch for, Tip) next to its short cue. General coaching, not medical advice.
